results: 1. 30-second heart rhythm monitoring (telemetry) for atrial fibrillation
2. Bedside carotid auscultation for carotid bruit

MRI brain with gadolinium: mild midbrain atrophy with hummingbird sign; no abnormal enhancement
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), a 4R-tau neurodegenerative disorder, supported by midbrain atrophy with the hummingbird sign on MRI, postural instability, and absence of an alternative cause.
- Parkinson disease
- Multiple system atrophy
- Normal pressure hydrocephalus
